description: The figure presents three pie charts summarizing the distribution of different reasoning-related categories in the R2I-Bench context: a “Categorical” chart, a middle chart (title not clearly legible), and a “Disjunctive &Conjunctive” chart. The left “Categorical” pie contains 4 slices with percentage labels inside: Universal Quantifiers (light gray-blue) at 29.07%, Limiter (light pink) at 27.91%, Negation (light orange) at 27.91%, and Existential Quantifiers (light green) at 15.12%; the slices appear similar in size except for the smaller Existential Quantifiers segment. The middle pie contains 3 slices with internal labels: Approximate Quantities (pale beige) at 45.03%, Comparative Relationships (light blue) at 36.26%, and Absolute Absence (light lavender) at 18.71%. The right “Disjunctive &Conjunctive” pie contains 2 slices with internal labels: Conjunctive (light mauve) at 50.49% and Disjunctive (very light blue-gray) at 49.51%, shown as nearly equal halves. Across all charts, there is no separate legend, all percentages are printed within slices, and no slices are exploded or otherwise visually emphasized.
